mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 48 degrees and clear at Verona City Hall, with a beautiful full moon tonight. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

City officials remind us that a portion of Highway M will be closed from October 5 to October 7 for road work. Also, please be aware of a scam involving fake emails asking for planning fees; always verify with the city at 608-848-9941.

There is plenty to do this week, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out yoga at Insight Wellness, and look forward to trivia and the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park later this week.

In a report covering late August through mid-September, police noted that on September 5, officers received reports of several vehicles pranked with cheese slices on their windshields in the downtown area.
Today's flavor is Turtle, and the team will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
